lines.text: I would like to pay, please.
Many learners say: I want to pay, please.
Better: I would like to pay, please.
Would like! I would like to pay, please.

data.right: I would like to pay, please.

native.tip: Im Deutschen sagen wir „Ich möchte zahlen.“ Viele übersetzen „möchte“ mit „want“, aber das klingt hart. Besser ist „would like“.
native.caption: Möchten Sie höflich die Rechnung verlangen? 💳 Falsch: “I want to pay, please.” Richtig: “I would like to pay, please.” Hören Sie Ama zu und sprechen Sie nach! Mehr üben in der Lexkite-App.

en.tip: German says “Ich möchte zahlen.” Many say “want” in English, but it sounds hard. “Would like” is more polite.
en.caption: German “möchte” is “would like”! Wrong: “I want to pay, please.” Right: “I would like to pay, please.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
